name: tryhackme-mcp
description: Search TryHackMe rooms, study tasks, follow paths, check your progress, and manage lab machines.
long_description: Unofficial MCP server for TryHackMe. Public content works without login. Add your connect.sid session cookie for your stats, path progress and recommendations. Account-changing tools (machines, votes, joining rooms) stay off unless you enable them.

thm_session.title: TryHackMe session cookie (connect.sid)
thm_session.description: Optional. From tryhackme.com: DevTools > Application > Cookies > connect.sid. Leave empty for public content only.

allow_writes.title: Allow account changes
allow_writes.description: Enable tools that start/stop machines, vote and join rooms.
